inference_limits.personnel_to_selection: Source inspection shows fitness_offense includes personnel and the generic probe fallback sorts eligible surplus evaluations by fitness_offense, so personnel is a possible contributor. Retained runtime evidence does not establish that rs4 reached that fallback, its actual rank, or that personnel caused selection.
inference_limits.personnel_writer: UNMEASURED. Existing movement_phase snapshots omit personnel. Adding before/after personnel can identify a phase interval in which the value changed, but cannot by itself identify the actual assignment/writer if multiple writers execute inside that phase.
inference_limits.n80_reconstruction: UNMEASURED because n80 records git_dirty=true and retained artifacts do not reconstruct its exact uncommitted source state.

findings.finding: 778-result pass=true overstates compliance with the ordered plan. Trace extraction started at 08:05:31Z and targeted extraction at 08:08:55Z; selector/schema controls started later at 08:10:26Z. The controls passed, but the required controls-before-extraction sequence was not met.
findings.disposition: Retain as a process residual. Do not rerun unchanged extraction merely to manufacture false preflight provenance.

findings.finding: The exploratory PowerShell parser failure exited 1 before the retained scripts and has no preserved-preflight receipt.
findings.disposition: 778 reports it accurately. Do not invent a receipt or recast it as a preserved attempt.

findings.finding: The 778 recommendation combines diagnostic source preparation with an unapproved preserved 24-week observer run and hard-codes turn-23 Sarajevo-Romanija rows in the proposed production observer path.
findings.disposition: Correct the next action to observer-only preparation at the two precise missing boundaries. Use generic configured selectors, keep diagnostics default-off, preserve thresholds and selection behavior, and make no Sarajevo/turn-23 production branch. A measurement run or horizon requires a separate owner decision.

corrected_next_scope.authorized_interpretation: No gameplay fix is justified. Prepare observer-only diagnostics, without changing thresholds, selection, state, saves, or outputs when disabled.
corrected_next_scope.personnel_boundary: Add generic, selector-scoped, default-off personnel presence/value and pre/post phase deltas. Treat a changing phase only as localization; add a more precise assignment/writer receipt if actual writer identity is required.
corrected_next_scope.probe_boundary: At the reached generic probe fallback, emit the complete reached candidate/filter/fitness/rank/selected tuple through commander_creation under generic selectors. Do not hard-code Sarajevo, turn 23, brigade IDs or objectives in production source.
corrected_next_scope.measurement_boundary: Do not run the proposed 24-week observer reproduction under authority 777. Present a separate measurement question, cost and stopping rule for owner approval. Any later abbreviated observer run is diagnostic only and cannot waive the authoritative 188-week acceptance criterion.
corrected_next_scope.stop_condition: Stop after observer preparation and cheap source/control verification. Do not execute an engine run, replay, runTurn, campaign, suite, test or build in this review.

preservation.retained_posture: n80=703 remains NO-GO/unadopted; n81/n82=689 remain rejected. All telemetry, source and thresholds remain preserved.
